race.description: The Butcher Mildura - The Junior Boss Is Back Pace
race.comment: BERSAGLIERE (7) was 5.5 metres away in second at Gawler over 1609m last start at his first run back from a spell. Should enjoy a nice smother from this draw and will be looking for a split at some stage. Stepping up a level this time but he is fitter for that last hit-out and capable of another big performance. MY ULTIMATE HENRY (2) led at his most recent outing and saluted in a nice return to form at this track over 2190m, getting home by 5.5 metres. Meets a similar line up so he can add to the strong recent effort. CELESTIAL NEBULAE (11) is open to further improvement at the third run back from a break after getting home last time out over 2100m at Charlton. Likely to be around the mark again. RONZEL RAFA (10) is worth some thought after his last-start sixth over 1790m at this circuit on August 21.
